Reject modules/dicts/numbers/bytes/bad __fspath__ return values with TypeError regardless of silent. Preserve string module names, comma-list/glob and PathLike real-file behavior plus optional None/empty/no-match semantics. Do not stringify arbitrary objects into pretend paths, mutate input sequences or modify the general ensure_a_list contract across unrelated APIs.
